findings.text: _reviewed_run_id re-implements the repository-owned resolution of a review node id to its run: reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:218 _resolved_reviewed_run_id already does the same startswith-r- check, the same live-fleet scan for a matching node id, and adds a durable-row fallback this copy omits, and dispatch_admission._reviewed_run_id_for_node already reaches it in production. A review of a run whose live pointer is gone therefore resolves to the bare source here where the owner would resolve the durable row, so the pane can draw an in-review row under a node name that names no run.

The added guard `if kind == START_KIND and run_id and (...)` is not ruff-formatted: `ruff format --check` on ticker.py reports 1 file would be reformatted and the only hunk is this block, while both production files were format-clean at base 8bdae2430, so the node's done-when clause that ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths against the base is not met.

`assert "delivered" in drawn` is satisfied by the delivery row the test renders four lines earlier (grid.render(delivery) at line 124) and which stays on the grid, so it holds whatever the in-review row's left half draws; it does not test that the row reads delivered -> in review, which is the behaviour its docstring claims. `assert IMPL_NODE in drawn` at line 129 is weak for the same reason.

This file was edited (assertions at lines 94, 107, 142 and the flush at 58) although it is outside the node's declared write paths, and the node's own manifest records it as belonging to the concurrent node the-stream-carries-only-actionable-lines and as not edited; eleven test files outside the declared paths were changed in aeffe515f with no scope extension requested. The edits are coherent and necessary to the green population, but an exclusive write path was crossed unilaterally.

The landing record states CARRIED_PANE_WORDS grows to `{delivered, halted, in review, landed, dropped}`, but reckon/crew/ticker.py:393 carries only the first three and landing/dropped travel on LANDING_FIELD judged by _landing_is_news; the record misdescribes the rule the code ships.

The record contradicts itself: changed_paths lists tests/test_the_stream_carries_only_actionable_lines.py while the outside_scope paragraph states that file 'was not edited'. A reader cannot tell from the manifest which files the node actually touched.
